name: FAIL Academy
subtitle: Faculty of Arms, Inquiry & Lore
_baselineRevealed_note: Entities the party knows from the campaign's first moment rather than by discovering them — they are fifth-year students who have lived here five years. Applied once per id at load (see js/state.js), additive only: it never un-reveals anything and never overrides a DM's deliberate un-reveal. Session-earned discoveries belong in a session's reveals[], NOT here — with one documented exception, added 2026-08-24. A session's reveals[] only fires through the Session Runner, which lists sessions with category 'Planning' exactly. session_1 and session_2 were both reconciled to 'Completed' after being played, so their reveals[] can never fire and their discoveries would stay invisible in Player View forever. Those ids are therefore ALSO listed here so the app actually applies them. reveals[] on each session remains the authoritative record of which session earned what; this list is only the delivery mechanism. Session 3 was authored as 'Planning' but was likewise reconciled to 'Completed' after play (2026-09-03), so its reveals[] is listed here too. The exception is therefore standing rather than retired: any session that gets reconciled to 'Completed' needs its reveals[] mirrored here, whether or not the Runner was used at the table. Doing both is harmless — this list is applied once per id and is additive only. Expanded 2026-08-24 after an audit found 36 player-visible entities that were never revealed and therefore invisible in Player View: four faculty, three campus facilities, four campus creatures, both student clubs, the campaign overview, the standard health potion, plus Guntrah's own family/construct and the retired One Shots party, who are current underclassmen rather than strangers.
